title: Plane and Sport Cards
description: Layered fragments of printed ephemera—sports trading cards, Rolling Stones tongue-and-lips logos, a football, and gold compact discs—surround a central white panel bearing a black line-drawing of a military aircraft viewed from above. Vertical yellow and red tape stripes overlay the composition against a black ground, with holographic and green fabric elements visible near the top.
composition: central plane on taped panel with sport-card margins
